purpose: Directly accept or reject textureless moving-surface NVOF consensus as the missing moving-flash intrinsic-coverage mechanism.
invariant: Benchmark architecture 11 only; production architecture 0 remained unchanged and the candidate transported only a validated motion vector for raw-source comparison, never display RGB or event memory.
primary_gate: moving clear-to-5% <=70 ms; moving-flash reduction >=0.45; perceptual minimum reduction >=0.70; WCAG SC 2.3.1 and 2.3.2 pass
interpretation: Mode 11 again produced exactly the mode-8 moving-flash result, while slightly changing ordinary moving-square error, proving architecture mode 11 was active but its NVOF consensus did not add moving-flash authority. This rejects optical-flow infill as the next lever. The next candidate uses a different invariant: at a translating uniform object's interior, same-coordinate raw source remains unchanged for small displacement, whereas an intrinsic flash changes the whole interior; pixels near motion boundaries are excluded by four-sided current-surface support.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
